ὅς.en: ὅς word who, which, what, that, Mt. 1:16, 23, 25

ὅσος.en: ὅσος word as great, as much, Mk. 7:36

ὅτι.en: ὅτι (partícula): originally was the neuter of ὅστις, that, Mt. 2:16, 22, 23

ὑπεράνω.en: ὑπεράνω (preposição): can function as an improper prep., above, over, far above

ὑποκάτω.en: ὑποκάτω (preposição): can function as an improper prep., under, beneath, underneath, Mk. 6:11

ᾅδης.en: ᾅδης word the invisible abode or mansion of the dead
